# Parchment GUI

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/parchment-gui

License: CC0.

The importer keeps the middle 48x48 panel from `panels.png` as a 16px 9-slice
fallback parchment source. The active dialogue panel source is currently
`../old-parchment-paper/parchment_alpha.png`; this asset is used only when that
old parchment PNG is unavailable.
